g.text: The bigger the protein family, the better the latest Claude models, as for a protein language model

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: Next amino acid on 257 DUF families: 90 from 20 to 300 proteins, 30 per bin, and the 167 of Fig. 1; mean over families,

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: bands: 95% bootstrap CI for Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5. Purple diamonds: ProtGPT3-10B, a protein language model, on the same residues.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: Thin lines: earlier Claude models; grey: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 4 Carbon.
